problem_restatement: Determine whether every SOL hourly-cross one-blocker shadow lifecycle was an incremental opportunity relative to the unchanged v51 portfolio, rather than a counterfactual entry while canonical SOL exposure was already open.

root_cause.finding: The route-native shadow enforced one position only inside its hypothetical replay but did not attach the existing causal shared-portfolio classifier. Its pending long began after the canonical SOL long was already open, so it was not deployable incremental opportunity.
root_cause.failure_boundary: The source ledger retained the required pre-routing cohort snapshot, but the SOL observer report and improvement-digest adapter did not consume its portfolio classification.

decision: Keep the live SOL Range Onset route and hourly-cross blocker unchanged. Do not count the pending long counterfactual toward long-side coverage or opportunity capture. Continue only with later independent attempts that occur while canonical SOL is flat and portfolio capacity is available.
single_highest_value_next_investigation_: Capture the next source-resolved deployable SOL one-blocker episode while canonical SOL is flat; long-side coverage remains zero.
global_priority_note: The portfolio-wide digest still ranks exact SPCX and SP500 live-source lifecycle collection above this SOL experiment.

validation.red_test: The exact snapshot test failed with KeyError because no portfolio_journal existed despite a causal pre-routing OPEN snapshot.
validation.green_test: The same source-bound snapshot now classifies the long attempt as existing_symbol_position with deployable=0.
validation.focused_suite: 47 tests passed across the SOL command, shadow, shared-portfolio journal, prospective adapter, and continuous monitor integration.
validation.static_checks: Ruff check and format check passed; touched production files are <=500 lines and contain no functions over 50 lines.
validation.runtime_refresh: The report-only SOL observer and improvement monitor restarted with their prior arguments; the v51 live backend, checkpoint writer, positions, stops, configuration, sizing, and TUI were not changed.

proposal_contract.1_recommendation: Retain the hourly-cross requirement and collect only deployable flat-SOL prospective episodes.
proposal_contract.2_why_now: A raw pending long was being presented as prospective maturity even though v51 had already occupied SOL on the same move.
proposal_contract.3_evidence_reviewed: Exact v51 cohort snapshots and routing, SOL live ledger, public L2 and mark archive, official funding, immutable one-blocker replay, improvement digest, and focused regressions.
proposal_contract.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: Portfolio occupancy attribution overstated the one-blocker experiment's long-side evidence.
proposal_contract.5_applicable_market_regime: The excluded long and deployable short both occurred in the current v51 range-onset observation window; only the short is incremental portfolio evidence.
proposal_contract.6_alternatives_considered: Discard the counterfactual, infer occupancy from fills, or reuse the existing causal portfolio journal. Reusing the journal preserves the path while excluding it from deployable maturity.
proposal_contract.8_expected_upside: Prevents false evidence from supporting a harmful blocker relaxation and keeps incremental opportunity accounting honest.
proposal_contract.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse deployable outcomes, modeled rather than placed fills, missing future long coverage, and possible future portfolio-classification schema drift.
proposal_contract.10_validation_completed: TDD red-green reproduction, exact current-run refresh, causal shared-portfolio classification, digest ingestion, focused tests, formatting, line limits, and process-scope verification.
proposal_contract.11_validation_still_required: Additional independent deployable long and short episodes with exact fees, funding, depth, stop, opposite-signal, and maximum-hold outcomes.
proposal_contract.12_success_metrics: At least ten deployable resolved shorts and three deployable resolved longs; positive after-cost net and PF above one; positive ex-largest-winner net; zero unresolved portfolio or venue-path attribution.
proposal_contract.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any occupied or capacity-blocked attempt advancing deployable maturity, any source identity mismatch, or any report-only change affecting live authority requires immediate rollback and evidence invalidation.
proposal_contract.14_confidence_level: High on the attribution defect and corrected current-run counts; low on strategy expectancy because only one deployable lifecycle exists and it lost.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The shared-portfolio snapshot proves deployability state, not a hypothetical venue fill.
One deployable short loss cannot establish the full strategy expectancy.
The raw long path remains useful counterfactual trajectory evidence but is non-additive and non-incremental.
Future attempts may be excluded by portfolio capacity or same-cycle action even when SOL itself is flat.
falsifiers: The frozen report fails to reproduce one deployable short and one existing-symbol-position long.
The canonical SOL lifecycle was not open before the excluded long routing decision.
The improvement digest later reports the excluded long as deployable or active pending without a new flat-SOL attempt.
A later predeclared deployable sample becomes positive after costs and largest-winner removal with both sides represented.
